The claim diverges from the bound NCT on indication (lupus vs psoriasis), phase (2b vs 3), endpoint family (BICLA vs PASI/sPGA), and enrollment magnitude (408 vs 1,700+) — this is a different trial entirely. The catalyst is the LUMUS lupus readout; the flagged psoriasis-endpoint description is not relevant to the bound catalyst trial.
